description:
Dive into the  world of turtles and tortoises! 🐢 Discover the key differences between these shelled reptiles, from their habitats and physical traits to their unique behaviors. Learn intriguing facts, such as:

Longevity Legends: Some tortoises can live over 200 years, making them among the longest-living land animals.

Ancient Lineage: Turtles have roamed the Earth for over 200 million years, predating many other reptile species.

Distinctive Features: While tortoises are land dwellers with dome-shaped shells and sturdy legs, turtles are adapted for aquatic life with streamlined shells and webbed feet.
